title: Fallout 1/2/3 Alien Contact and Alien-Technology Continuity Audit
scope: Disambiguate what 'aliens' means in Fallout 2, identify actual shipped alien-technology claims, and compare them with earlier Fallout alien traces and Fallout 3's explicit Mothership Zeta abduction system.

fallout1.interpretation: Fallout already contained extraterrestrial/UFO imagery before Fallout 2 and Bethesda's formal Zetan expansion.
fallout1.claim_ceiling: Do not retroactively treat every reused large-headed skeleton asset as extraterrestrial.

wanamingos.finding: The word 'alien' in Fallout 2 random encounters is not enough to establish a Zetan.

Skynet.statement_semantics: Skynet says its thinking-computer development was perfected through use of alien technology.
Skynet.importance: This is the strongest direct Fallout 2 bridge between extraterrestrial technology and a human-made artificial intelligence system.
Skynet.claim_ceiling: The exact alien donor civilization, component and transfer route are not specified.

Sierra_large_headed_subject.note: The visual alien-like skeleton asset is reused, but the Sierra experiment log explains this instance as a human Mentats experiment with enlarged cranium.

Palandine.finding: Pre-War U.S. authorities documented an alien craft entering airspace and crashing north of Hagerstown; recovery failed.

Theta.relation: Lone Wanderer approaches beacon and is abducted by Mothership Zeta.

Outcasts.evidence: Protector Casdin has unique dialogue that alien blaster and alien power cells warrant study.

Mothership_Zeta.distinction: Far more explicit and systemic than Fallout 2's shipped alien-tech traces.

janus_genesis_extension.finding: Fallout 2's strongest alien bridge is technological and epistemic rather than a live-contact scene: an AI explicitly attributes part of its technological ancestry to alien technology.
janus_genesis_extension.claim_ceiling: Structural comparison only; this does not prove Genesis or real AI has extraterrestrial ancestry.

targets: enumerate all Sierra Army Depot shipped dialogue/log lines concerning alien technology
search item/terminal records for the actual component or project that Skynet calls alien technology

source_register.role: human explanation for reused alien-like skeleton
